Power supply

______ is a very useful and important circuit in the dc power supply unit as it does the major conversion of the ac voltage to a pulsating dc voltage.
rectifier circuit
The rectifier circuit is a very useful and important circuit in the dc power supply unit as it does the major conversion of the ac voltage to a pulsating dc voltage.
______ is a very popular active device due to the fact that it is relatively easy to tailor to fit any particular application.
Operational Amplifier
The Operational Amplifier is a very popular active device due to the fact that it is relatively easy to tailor to fit any particular application.
______ is a circuit that converts a pulsating output from a rectifier into a very steady dc level as it filters out or smoothens out the pulsations in the output.
filter circuit
The filter circuit is a circuit that converts a pulsating output from a rectifier into a very steady dc level as it filters out or smoothens out the pulsations in the output.
______ is an electronic control circuit which is capable of providing a nearly constant dc output voltage even when there are variations in load or input voltage.
regulator

operation
